title: Open-Meteo historical archive — New York City grid point 40.738N 74.043W, 26 October – 2 November 2026
claims: The query returns eight daily records for 26 October to 2 November 2026 at a New York City grid point resolved to 40.738 N / 74.043 W at 32 m elevation.
Daily maximum temperature across the eight days ranges from 15.9°C to 21.8°C, with a median of 18.0°C.
Daily minimum temperature across the eight days ranges from 4.4°C to 10.9°C, with a median of 7.3°C.
One of the eight days records measurable precipitation (0.4 mm on 28 October), and no day reaches 1 mm.
On race day, 1 November 2026, the daily maximum is 16.1°C, the daily minimum is 4.4°C and precipitation is 0.0 mm.
The values are modelled or reanalysis data for a grid point, not measurements on the course, at the start village or on the bridge decks.
